name: spielos
description: Turn recurring business work into reusable AI workflows with company context, evaluation and review.

interface.longDescription:
Give your AI a company to work for—and work it can get better at.

SpielOS turns recurring business work into reusable workflows for Codex and Claude Code. Ask Director to research leads, prepare a report or draft an outbound campaign. It helps define the inputs, sources, permissions and quality criteria, then build and test the process.

Keep your company context, scoped memory, workflows and decisions in a folder you control. Your local dashboard shows actual work, pending decisions, evaluation evidence and available usage. Missing usage and billing remain unknown.

Setup helps you select or create a company, checks Python 3.11+ and offers a Langfuse connection or local-only work. Open your company as your workspace and review its hooks through your host's normal controls. Project keys stay in a private local form, outside chat. Your company folder remains yours when the plugin is updated or removed.

Local tracking, drafts and candidate experiments need no Langfuse account. Production workflow qualification currently requires verified Langfuse evidence and independent review. Sending and publishing require separate approval for the exact action. Passing a test alone does not prove improvement or business impact.

Installation connects no external service and does not automatically trust hooks. This is trusted local software; enterprise isolation and untrusted-code sandboxing are not claimed.
defaultPrompt: Director, build an outbound email workflow for [ICP]. Research fit, draft emails and require review before sending.
Director, build a lead research agent for [ICP] that cites sources and explains each fit score.
Director, turn our [recurring task] into a tested workflow. Agree quality criteria and compare actual results.

prompts: Set up SpielOS in a new company folder that I choose.
Show what is recorded about my company without starting work.
Help me test a weekly report workflow before I release it.

publication.release_notes: Stable completion receipts: preserve original Stop elapsed time across session close, retain actual usage, and request the full canonical receipt in Codex and Claude Code with a one-pass guard.
